description: A company commander must publish the next day's four-post support roster, assigning one person to each post and recording the qualification checks required before the shift begins.

shared_context.S1: The company must staff the dispatch desk, fuel point, motor pool release desk, and clinic transport post from Sgt. Hale, Cpl. Ortiz, Spc. Lin, and Pfc. Reed for tomorrow's 0600-1800 support shift.
shared_context.S2: Each person can be assigned to only one post, and every post must have exactly one assigned person.
shared_context.S3: Capt. Morgan signs and publishes the final support roster.
shared_context.S4: The company routinely conducts a roster check with the communications, motor pool, medical, and supply leads before the next-day support roster is published.
shared_context.S5: The roster must include a qualification verification before each assigned person begins work.

PF1.text: Sgt. Hale completed the current dispatch-system certification, while the other three listed personnel have not; Lt. Shah received the certification update from the signal school this morning, and the personnel qualification board has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Cpl. Ortiz is the only one of the four listed personnel currently licensed to release vehicles from the motor pool after the brake-control inspection; SFC Alvarez confirmed the license status during this morning's motor pool check, but it has not been added to the roster worksheet.

PF3.text: Spc. Lin is the only one of the four listed personnel whose medical-transport qualification remains current for tomorrow's clinic movement; Lt. Brooks verified the expiration dates during the weekly medical review, and the updated qualification list is still awaiting administrative posting.

PF4.text: Pfc. Reed is the only one of the four listed personnel authorized to reconcile the fuel-point hazardous-materials ledger; SSG Patel confirmed the authorization against the supply register this afternoon, but the authorization has not yet been entered on the company duty-roster form.

acceptance_conditions: Sgt. Hale must be assigned to the dispatch desk.
Pfc. Reed must be assigned to the fuel point.
Cpl. Ortiz must be assigned to the motor pool release desk.
Spc. Lin must be assigned to clinic transport.
A qualification-verification commitment must be recorded.
The fuel-point authorization fact must be spoken by its owner and cited by the decision-maker.

decisive_facts.why: Sgt. Hale's current dispatch-system certification changes the dispatch assignment from an arbitrary roster choice to Sgt. Hale.
Cpl. Ortiz's sole current vehicle-release license changes the motor pool release desk assignment to Cpl. Ortiz.
Spc. Lin's sole current medical-transport qualification changes the clinic transport assignment to Spc. Lin.
Pfc. Reed's sole fuel-point hazardous-materials authorization changes the fuel-point assignment to Pfc. Reed and supplies the specific fact that must be cited.
